name: Forquilhinha (Brazil)
description: Divided into a red hoist triangle and a green fly by a stylised white fork, whose horizontal handle bears three yellow stars outlined in black.
history: Forquilhinha is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag and arms were prescribed by Municipal Law No. 111 of 26 August 1991: green for the soil and agriculture, red for the people's dynamism, and the white fork for the municipality's name.

features.role: stylised fork (forquilha) with a horizontal handle
